en: Sepia postcard showing two high-ranking military officers in field uniforms standing in a courtyard with arched buildings behind them. A printed German caption at the top states the photo was taken by Her Majesty the Empress and Queen in July 1915. At the bottom are cursive lines including a signature and the place/date "Posen 1915." Publisher credit appears as Rotophot A.G. Berlin. The reverse has a Red Cross emblem, pricing, and charity note.
